rules.own-oc-at-np-use: Initial OC fixes the starting gauge. The shared executor freezes base OC plus live included boosts (cap 5) before NP functions, chooses that use's OC cells, and consumes participating instances at action end.
rules.canonical-exclusive-state: A known exclusive state proves sibling absence in the shared condition reader; calculator and ranking do not infer that truth independently.
rules.coexisting-negative-target-state: A normalized enemy rate grant retains its existing negative target-state mutation, and normal damage projection consumes the committed application outcome once.
